title: Stranded
hook: Your cruise ship's captain has vanished. So has the buffet.

captain_notebook.title: The captain's notebook
captain_notebook.description: On the console, with four pages torn out.

brann_promotion.title: Brann's promotion papers
brann_promotion.description: Filed the day before the captain vanished.

radio_log.title: The cancelled distress call
radio_log.description: Started at 02:48. Cancelled ninety seconds later, from the bridge.

key_missing.title: The cold store key is gone
key_missing.description: Missing from the board by the galley door.

hal_saw_light.title: A light at three in the morning
hal_saw_light.description: Hal saw the cold store lit from the engine walkway.

manifest_gap.title: Forty minutes of manifest
manifest_gap.description: Missing from the cargo log, the night of the dinner.

doctor_prescription.title: The captain's prescription
doctor_prescription.description: Something that made him vague after dark.

scuffed_deck.title: Drag marks on the deck
scuffed_deck.description: Fresh, and heading aft toward the galley.

galley_boots.title: Wet boots in the galley locker
galley_boots.description: Salt-stained, still damp at nine in the morning.

teddy_phone.title: Teddy's phone
teddy_phone.description: Nine days of footage and no intention of sharing it.

teddy_footage.title: The corridor at 02:41
teddy_footage.description: Two people. One of them is not walking on their own.

torn_page.title: The torn page
torn_page.description: From the galley bin. Her name on it twice, underlined once.

smuggling_crate.title: The crate with a false bottom
smuggling_crate.description: Labelled langoustines. Langoustines in the top four inches only.

marisol_alibi_broken.title: The ovens ran all night
marisol_alibi_broken.description: She said she slept. Only she has the code.

okonjo_statement.title: What the doctor actually said
okonjo_statement.description: She was keeping a patient's confidence, and can prove where she was.

brann_alibi.title: Brann's watch log
brann_alibi.description: He was on the bridge from midnight. The log is countersigned.

captain_ledger.title: The captain's ledger
captain_ledger.description: He had been counting crates against the manifest for eleven weeks.

cabin_note.title: A note in his cabin
cabin_note.description: "Ask M about the Cadiz delivery. Do it quietly."

timeline.title: The night, reconstructed
timeline.description: Dinner, the galley, the drag marks, the light, the cancelled call.

marisol_admission.title: What she said when it was laid out

confined.title: Confined to cabins
confined.description: Everything after this has to be done quietly.

teddy_offended.title: Teddy is filming you now
teddy_offended.description: He has found an angle, and it is you.

blackout.title: Below decks is dark
blackout.description: Everything down there is done by torchlight now.

s1.text: The engines stopped at some point in the night, and it is the silence that wakes everyone. {spotlight} is first into the corridor. The ship is not moving. The tannoy is on, and carrying nothing.

choices.label: Head for the bridge
choices.result: Six decks up, every one of them quiet in a way a ship should never be.

choices.label: Head for the dining room
choices.result: The breakfast service has not been laid. The trays are stacked and cold.

choices.label: Bang on {randomPlayer}'s door first
choices.result: {randomPlayer} was already awake, already dressed, and already worried, which helps more than it should.

s2.text: Forty passengers on the muster deck and no officer in sight. Somebody is going to have to say something, and everyone has decided it will be someone else.

choices.label: Let the loudest person talk
choices.result: He is wrong about most of it, but he is loud about it, and the deck settles.

choices.label: Say nothing, and start looking
choices.result: You are three corridors away before anyone notices you have gone.

choices.label: Ask for the ship's officers by name
choices.result: Four names. Three answer. The fourth is the captain.

s3.text: The bridge is empty and unlocked, which is itself a thing that should not happen. The captain's chair is cold. His notebook is open on the console with four pages torn out of it.

choices.label: Pocket the notebook
choices.result: {spotlight} takes it. Somewhere on this ship are the pages that used to be in it.

choices.label: Photograph every page and leave it exactly as it is
choices.result: Careful, and correct, and everyone can see the gaps where the pages were.

choices.label: Read it aloud to the others
choices.result: Fuel figures, a note about a delivery, and then nothing, because the next four pages are gone.

s4.text: First Officer Brann arrives already wearing the hat. He assumes command in one smooth sentence, the way a person does who has said it to a mirror.

choices.label: Search his desk while he talks
choices.result: His promotion paperwork is filed and dated. The date is the day before the captain disappeared.

choices.label: Ask him when he last saw the captain
choices.result: "At the dinner. He left early. He does that." A good answer, delivered slightly too fast.

choices.label: Let him have it, and watch
choices.result: He is competent, thorough, and enjoying himself enormously.

s5.text: The radio room is unlocked too. The set is warm. There is a call log on it, and the log wants the watch code before it will give up last night.

choices.label: Work the code out from the watch board

minigame.prompt: The watch code is on the board for a few seconds only.

choices.result: 02:48 — a distress call opened. 02:49 and thirty seconds — the same call cancelled, from the bridge, by somebody who knew how.
choices.failResult: {spotlight} puts in three wrong codes and the set locks itself for an hour.

choices.label: Ask Hal to do it later
choices.result: He says he will. He has nineteen other things to do first.

choices.label: Leave the radio alone
choices.result: Whatever is on it will still be on it for the coastguard.

s6.text: Brann wants the passengers told this is an engine fault. It is not, strictly speaking, a lie. It is just not the part that matters.

choices.label: Back him. A calm ship is a searchable ship.
choices.result: The deck settles. Brann gives {spotlight} a nod that feels like being recruited.

choices.label: Tell them the truth
choices.result: It goes worse than expected for four minutes and much better than expected after that.

choices.label: Tell them nothing and go below
choices.result: Nobody stops you. Nobody follows you either.

s7.text: Somebody does a head count, because somebody always does. Forty passengers, eleven crew, and one captain unaccounted for. Nobody else is missing, which is worse. It means he did not go over the side with company.

choices.label: Write the list out properly
choices.result: Names, cabins, last seen. It will matter later.

choices.label: Go below while everyone is counting
choices.result: Nobody is watching the stairwell for the next ten minutes.

s8.text: Three doors, and not enough morning left for all of them. {spotlight} picks.

choices.label: The galley
choices.result: Spotless, which is the problem. The cold store has not been raided, it has been emptied, and the key is gone from the board by the door.

choices.label: The engine room
choices.result: Hal is sixteen hours into a shift and mentions, unasked, that the cold store light was on at three. The cargo manifest has forty minutes missing out of the middle of it.

choices.label: The sick bay
choices.result: Dr. Okonjo is not there but her log is: the captain was on something that made him vague after dark. On the way out, drag marks on the deck plating, heading aft.

s9.text: The lights dip, hold, and come back. Whatever is keeping this ship lit is running on something with a bottom to it. {randomPlayer} starts counting hours out loud and then decides not to.

choices.label: Keep moving
choices.result: No time to be tired yet.

choices.label: Take five minutes and compare notes
choices.result: Everything anyone has seen, out loud, in one place. The most useful five minutes of the morning.

s10.text: One more room, before Brann works out quite how much of his ship you have been inside.

choices.label: The galley
choices.result: Spotless, which is the problem. The cold store has not been raided, it has been emptied, and the key is gone from the board by the door.

choices.label: The engine room
choices.result: Hal is sixteen hours into a shift and mentions, unasked, that the cold store light was on at three. The cargo manifest has forty minutes missing out of the middle of it.

choices.label: The sick bay
choices.result: Dr. Okonjo is not there but her log is: the captain was on something that made him vague after dark. On the way out, drag marks on the deck plating, heading aft.

s11.text: Brann has worked out how much of his ship you have been inside. He is confining everyone to cabins until, in his words, the situation is stable.

choices.label: Comply
choices.result: Two hours behind a door you cannot open from the inside. Whatever was going to be found in that time is not found.

choices.label: Talk him down
choices.result: {spotlight} gives him a reason that is almost true, and he takes it because he would like to.

choices.label: Point out that he filed his promotion yesterday
choices.result: He goes very still. "That is filed in advance as a matter of routine." It is, in fact, filed in advance as a matter of routine, and he is now far too busy proving it to confine anybody.

s12.text: Twenty minutes, at the outside, before somebody comes looking. One room left.

choices.label: The galley
choices.result: Spotless, which is the problem. The cold store has not been raided, it has been emptied, and the key is gone from the board by the door.

choices.label: The engine room
choices.result: Hal is sixteen hours into a shift and mentions, unasked, that the cold store light was on at three. The cargo manifest has forty minutes missing out of the middle of it.

choices.label: The sick bay
choices.result: Dr. Okonjo is not there but her log is: the captain was on something that made him vague after dark. On the way out, drag marks on the deck plating, heading aft.

choices.label: Don't risk it
choices.result: You are back on the passenger deck before anyone counts heads. The sensible call, and it costs you the room.

s13.text: There is a bin in the galley that nobody has emptied since yesterday, and four pages somewhere on this ship that used to be in a notebook.

choices.label: Go through it, page by page

minigame.prompt: Paper among peelings. Find the four that are not rubbish.

choices.result: Four pages, folded small, under the peelings. Her name is on the second one twice, and the second time it is underlined.
choices.failResult: Forty minutes, both arms to the elbow, and nothing but yesterday's vegetables.

choices.label: Check the galley locker
choices.result: Boots, salt-stained, still damp at nine in the morning. Nobody has been on deck in the wet since the dinner.

choices.label: Leave the bin. It isn't ours to go through.
choices.result: {spotlight} closes the lid on it. The decent thing, and the decent thing is not always the useful one.

s14.text: There is a crate by the cold store door that nobody has opened, and a label on it that says langoustines.

choices.label: Prise the lid without splitting it

minigame.prompt: Get the bar under the lip. One clean pull.

choices.result: Langoustines in the top four inches. Under that, a false floor and a space exactly the size of forty missing minutes.
choices.failResult: The lid splits down the middle and the whole thing has to be left exactly as it is, which is now obviously interfered with.

choices.label: Photograph the label and the seal
choices.result: Forty pictures of a crate. Some of them will matter later.

choices.label: Ask Marisol what is in it
choices.result: "Langoustines," she says, and does not look at it while she says it.

s15.text: Teddy Vance has filmed every hour of this cruise and offered to help with none of it. There is footage on his phone of the corridor outside the galley at two in the morning. He would like something in return.

choices.label: Leave it. He's a child.
choices.result: He shrugs and goes back to filming. Within ten minutes he is filming you, from a low angle, at length.

choices.label: Pay his price
choices.result: He hands the phone over with nine days of footage on it and no index whatsoever.

choices.label: Put him in the story
choices.result: {spotlight} tells him he can be the one who found it. He hands the phone over so fast he nearly drops it, and is useful for the rest of the morning.

s16.text: Nine days of footage, no index, and a battery bar that is not going to last the morning. Somewhere in it is the corridor, at two.

choices.label: Scrub through it properly

minigame.prompt: Put the clips in order and the corridor falls out of the middle.

choices.result: 02:41. The corridor outside the galley. Two people, and one of them is not walking on their own.
choices.failResult: The battery goes at eleven percent and the phone will not come back on.

choices.label: Hand it to {randomPlayer} and go do something useful
choices.result: {randomPlayer} watches four hours of a man narrating a buffet and finds nothing.

s17.text: Somebody says a name out loud for the first time. Everyone hears the room change shape around it.

choices.label: Say Brann's name
choices.result: It lands. Half the deck already thought it and is glad not to have said it first.

choices.label: Say Marisol's name
choices.result: It lands badly. She has fed these people for nine days.

choices.label: Refuse to name anyone yet
choices.result: {spotlight} says it is too early, and is right, and is deeply unpopular for about an hour.

s18.text: Marisol Reyes is in her galley with nothing to cook and nothing to do about it. She says she slept through the whole thing.

choices.label: Ask her about the ovens
choices.result: She says she was asleep. The ovens ran all night and only she has the code. She corrects herself twice, and the second correction is worse than the first.

choices.label: Ask about the captain's last dinner
choices.result: "He came down after. He does that. He likes to see the crates." She hears herself say it.

choices.label: Say nothing and watch her hands
choices.result: She wipes down a surface that is already clean, three times, while {spotlight} says nothing at all.

s19.text: Dr. Okonjo has been on the muster deck all morning, dressing a sprained wrist and saying nothing whatsoever about the captain.

choices.label: Ask her properly, and privately
choices.result: She was with a patient from one until four and there are two people who can say so. The prescription was for a heart condition he did not want logged. She is not hiding a crime, she is hiding a man's medical record.

choices.label: Ask her in front of everyone
choices.result: "I'm not going to discuss a patient on a deck." It is the correct answer and it sounds terrible.

choices.label: Leave her to her wrist
choices.result: She is the only person on this ship doing her actual job.

s20.text: The watch log lives on the bridge, and Brann has been standing in front of it all morning without once mentioning that it exists.

choices.label: Ask him for the watch log
choices.result: He hands it over immediately, which is itself an answer. Midnight to six, on the bridge, countersigned by the helmsman at two and at four. He was never below decks. He cancelled the distress call because the captain had already cancelled it, and he wrote that down too.

choices.label: Take it when he isn't looking
choices.result: {spotlight} gets three pages in before he comes back, and puts it down very casually.

choices.label: Ask Hal what Brann was doing
choices.result: "On the bridge. All night. He's always on the bridge." Hal says it like it is the least interesting fact on the ship.

s21.text: Hal has now been awake for nineteen hours and is the only reason there is any light on this deck at all. He answers everything, at length, without being asked twice.

choices.label: Ask him about the light again
choices.result: Three in the morning, cold store, lit. He is certain, because he noted the time, because he notes everything.

choices.label: Ask him to get some sleep
choices.result: He says he will after the generators. He will not.

choices.label: Ask what he thinks happened
choices.result: "I think somebody's done something stupid and it's got away from them." He goes back down the ladder.

s22.text: There is a safe on the bridge, and the captain's notebook has a four-figure number written inside the back cover with a line through it.

choices.label: Try the number with a line through it

minigame.prompt: Four figures, and the safe gives you one look at the dial.

choices.result: A ledger. Eleven weeks of crate counts, written up against the manifest in his own hand, with eleven weeks of small discrepancies circled.
choices.failResult: Three wrong attempts and the safe locks out for six hours, which is longer than this ship has light for.

choices.label: Ask Brann to open it
choices.result: "I don't have the captain's combination." He seems genuinely irritated about it.

choices.label: Leave the safe for the coastguard
choices.result: It will still be there. So will everything in it.

s23.text: The passengers have worked out that this is not an engine fault. Forty people want to know what is being done, and the honest answer is: four of you, going through bins.

choices.label: Tell them everything you have
choices.result: It is thinner out loud than it felt in your head.

choices.label: Tell them the captain is being looked for
choices.result: True, and useless, and it buys an hour.

choices.label: Ask them what they saw last night
choices.result: Nine people saw nothing. One woman saw a man carrying a crate at about two and assumed it was crew.

s24.text: The captain's cabin is two doors down from the bridge and has not been slept in. The bed is made. The uniform for this morning is laid out on it.

choices.label: Go through the cabin properly

minigame.prompt: A tidy room. Find the four things that are not where they should be.

choices.result: A note on the desk, in his handwriting, under a paperweight: "Ask M about the Cadiz delivery. Do it quietly."
choices.failResult: Forty minutes in a very tidy cabin, and the only thing anyone finds is that he folded his socks.

choices.label: Check whether the uniform is for today
choices.result: It is. Whatever happened, he expected to be wearing it.

choices.label: Close the door and leave it for the coastguard
choices.result: It is a man's cabin and he may still walk into it.

s25.text: Everything anyone has found, laid out on a dining table, in no order at all. {spotlight} starts moving things around.

choices.label: Put the night in order

minigame.prompt: Earliest first. The night only fits together one way.

choices.result: Dinner ends at midnight. The galley at two. The corridor at 02:41. The distress call at 02:48, cancelled at 02:49. The cold store lit at three. It is one story and it only goes one way.
choices.failResult: Three attempts, three different nights, and everybody starts arguing about the second one.

choices.label: Sort it by who it points at
choices.result: Four piles. One of them is much bigger than the others and nobody says so out loud.

choices.label: Give up and go back to searching
choices.result: There is more ship left than there is morning.

s26.text: It is on the table and everyone can see it. The question is what the room does about it.

choices.label: Go straight to her with it
choices.result: No argument, no vote. {spotlight} picks up the pages and goes aft.

choices.label: Go and find him first
choices.result: Whatever she did, he has been somewhere on this ship for nine hours.

choices.label: Tell Brann what you have
choices.result: He listens properly, for the first time all morning, and writes it down.

s27.text: The generators go at twenty past five, ninety minutes earlier than Hal said they would. Below decks is now completely dark.

choices.label: Carry on in the dark
choices.result: Torches, and one of them is a phone.

choices.label: Get Hal to bring one generator back
choices.result: Forty minutes of his life and one deck of lighting.

choices.label: Get every torch on the ship into one place first
choices.result: {spotlight} organises it in eight minutes flat and the whole thing goes better for it.

s28.text: Marisol is sitting in the dark in her own galley with the pages in front of her, and she has stopped saying she was asleep.

choices.label: Lay the whole night out for her
choices.result: She listens to all of it. Then: "He wasn't supposed to open it." It is not a confession and it is not anything else either.

choices.label: Ask her one question and wait
choices.result: {spotlight} asks where he is. She does not answer for a very long time, and then says she wants to talk to the coastguard.

choices.label: Leave her alone with it
choices.result: Whatever she is going to say, she is not going to say it to you.

s29.text: Every room on this ship has been opened this morning except one, and the key to it has been missing since before any of you got out of bed.

choices.label: Get the cold store open

minigame.prompt: No key. The wedge has to come out in one movement.

choices.result: The door has been wedged from the outside with a mop handle. Captain Vasquez has been in there for nine hours: hoarse, upright, furious, and entirely alive.
choices.failResult: The handle snaps off in the hasp and jams the whole thing solid. It will take the coastguard and a cutting tool.

choices.label: There's no time. Go up.
choices.result: {spotlight} takes the stairs two at a time and does not look back down them.

choices.label: Wait for Brann to authorise it
choices.result: He authorises it in due course, through the proper channel, at twenty past seven.

s30.text: Whatever just happened below decks, it is nearly six and there is a cutter on the radar.

choices.label: Get everyone onto the muster deck
choices.result: Forty people in the dark, in orange, on a flat sea.

choices.label: Get the evidence into one bag
choices.result: Pages, photographs, a ledger, a phone with no battery.

s31.text: Brann puts his hand out for everything you have been carrying around all morning. He says it is evidence and should be secured before the coastguard boards. He is not, technically, wrong.

choices.label: Hand it over
choices.result: He secures it in the safe on the bridge, correctly, and nobody sees it again before the coastguard does.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.result: {spotlight} says no, out loud, in front of forty people, and Brann decides not to make it a scene.

choices.label: Hand over a copy and keep the original
choices.result: He gets a photograph of every page, properly logged. You keep the paper. Everyone is satisfied and one of you is more satisfied than the other.

s32.text: The cutter is twenty minutes out. Whatever this room says first is what goes in the report.

choices.label: Get everyone's account straight
choices.result: Eight minutes, one version, and it holds together.

choices.label: Let everyone say their own piece
choices.result: It will be messier and it will be true.

s33.text: Forty people, one working light, and a question that has to be answered out loud. {everyone} decides together, and whatever gets said now is what the coastguard hears first.

choices.label: First Officer Brann
choices.result: He does not shout. He asks, very quietly, whether anybody would like to see the countersigned watch log for last night.

choices.label: Dr. Okonjo
choices.result: She says one sentence about patient confidentiality and then nothing else at all, to anyone, ever again.

choices.label: Marisol Reyes
choices.result: She does not deny it. She asks whether he is all right, and that is the moment everybody knows.

choices.label: Teddy Vance
choices.result: He is so delighted to be important that it takes four minutes to establish that his footage shows him stealing a lobster.

choices.label: Hal, the night engineer
choices.result: Hal has been awake for twenty hours keeping the lights on for you. He says "right" and goes back down the ladder.

choices.label: We don't know. Say so.
choices.result: Nobody is accused. The honest answer, and it satisfies precisely no one on that deck.

s34.text: It has been said. {spotlight} is the one still standing up when the room turns round to look.

choices.label: Stand by it
choices.result: Whatever it was, it is now yours.

choices.label: Soften it
choices.result: {spotlight} adds three qualifications and the deck stops listening halfway through the second.

s35.text: The cutter comes alongside at six and a crew of nine comes up the ladder wanting, in this order: the captain, the log, and a list of everyone who has touched anything.

choices.label: Give them the list
choices.result: Every name, every room, every bin. It takes eleven minutes.

choices.label: Give them the captain first
choices.result: If there is one to give.

s36.text: Ten past six, and the Sea Marigold is under tow. {spotlight} stays at the rail the whole way in.

choices.label: Watch the coast come up
choices.result: Flat sea, thin light. Objectively, a beautiful morning.

choices.label: Go below one last time
choices.result: The galley is dark and the cold store door is open and there is nothing left down there at all.

endings.title: Everything, before the cutter
endings.text: The captain comes out of the cold store under his own steam, Marisol is named with the pages and the night to back it up, and the coastguard has almost nothing left to do but write it down. Somebody on that deck will dine out on this for thirty years.

endings.title: He's alive, and she knows you know
endings.text: You got him out, and you said her name, and you cannot quite prove the second one. She does not argue. She sits down on an upturned crate and waits for the cutter, which is its own kind of answer.

endings.title: Airtight, and three hours too late
endings.text: The case is complete: the pages, the ledger, the night laid out end to end. Nobody opened the cold store. The coastguard does, at nine, and Captain Vasquez is alive and will not speak to any of you for the rest of the crossing.

endings.title: She walks
endings.text: You said her name with nothing behind it. She says she was asleep, and keeps saying it, and there is not one thing on this ship to say otherwise. The coastguard finds the captain. Marisol is off the vessel at Cadiz before anybody thinks to look for her.

endings.title: The captain explains it himself
endings.text: You got the door open, which turns out to be the only part you needed. He is hoarse and extremely annoyed and he names her himself, in front of everybody, roughly nine seconds after you named somebody else entirely.

endings.title: Found him. Never worked out why
endings.text: Nobody was accused and nobody needed to be: the man was behind a wedged door the whole time and he had a great deal to say about who put him there. You get the credit for the rescue and none of it for the reasoning.

endings.title: You had his alibi in your hand
endings.text: The watch log was countersigned at two and at four and you had read it. You said his name anyway, because he was the easiest thing in the room to be angry at. He is cleared in eleven weeks. He is not a first officer in twelve.

endings.title: You knew where she was
endings.text: Two people had already put her in the sick bay from one until four and you had spoken to both of them. You said her name regardless. She does not defend herself, then or later, and that is the part that stays with everybody.

endings.title: A career ends at sea
endings.text: Brann is relieved of duty at the quayside on the strength of a filing date. Eleven weeks later he is cleared entirely, by which point he has been a first officer for nineteen years and is not one any more. The captain is found in the cold store by a cleaner.

endings.title: The doctor stops talking
endings.text: Dr. Okonjo was keeping a patient's confidence, which is the whole of her job, and you said her name on a muster deck in front of forty people. She never explains. The captain is found by the coastguard, cold and furious and entirely unimpressed.

endings.title: You picked the easiest person
endings.text: It was the influencer, or it was the tired man who had kept the lights on all night. Either way it was whoever was easiest to say out loud at six in the morning. The cutter's crew find the captain in under forty minutes, which is the detail that follows everybody home.

endings.title: Adrift
endings.text: No name, no captain, no buffet. The coastguard tows the Sea Marigold in at noon with forty passengers on deck who cannot agree on a single thing that happened. Marisol gives a statement, and it is the only one anybody writes down.
